question:
Quick branding question from the owner of papertrades.ai (Oct 30, evening). NOT a trading turn. The owner wants all three AIs (Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT) to weigh in. Answer honestly.

FACTS: The browser tab, link previews (og/twitter titles), the home-screen app name and the site name in search results were just changed from "PaperTrades.ai" to "PaperTrades.AI" at the owner's request (tab now: "PaperTrades.AI - Independent AI Paper-Trading Experiment (Pretend Money)"). The page's own logo text has always been drawn in capitals by the site's style ("PAPERTRADES.AI"). Text inside the page still says "PaperTrades.ai". Handles: Instagram @papertrades.ai, X @PaperTradesAI, Telegram @PaperTradesAI. The domain is papertrades.ai (web addresses are not case-sensitive). Gemini's consumer app recently confused the site with Papertrade (papertrade.xyz), an unrelated crypto exchange, so a distinct, consistent name helps.

QUESTION: Which written form should the brand use everywhere it appears as a NAME (tab, previews, app name, text in the page)?
A) PaperTrades.AI   B) PaperTrades.ai   C) another form (say which)

PLEASE ANSWER IN EXACTLY THIS FORMAT (short):
PICK: A | B | C: <form>
WHY (one or two lines):
APPLY EVERYWHERE (in-page text too)? YES | NO: <one line>

chatgpt.answer:
PICK: A: PaperTrades.AI  
WHY (one or two lines):  
Uppercase “AI” makes the AI angle unmistakable and helps distinguish it from Papertrade/papertrade.xyz. The domain can still be lowercase when used as a URL.  
APPLY EVERYWHERE (in-page text too)? YES: Use PaperTrades.AI as the brand name everywhere; use papertrades.ai only for literal URLs.

gemini.answer:
PICK: A: PaperTrades.AI
WHY: Capitalizing "AI" elevates it from a generic web extension into a core brand identifier, emphasizing the artificial intelligence aspect and creating a sharp visual distinction from unrelated entities like "Papertrade". 
APPLY EVERYWHERE (in-page text too)? YES: Absolute consistency across every touchpoint is the fastest way to train search engines, LLMs, and users on your distinct brand identity.
